# US Section 301 Tariffs on EVs & Batteries

To protect billions of dollars invested via the IRA, the US government weaponized Section 301 of the Trade Act. The tariffs impose a 100% duty on Chinese Electric Vehicles and a 25% duty on Chinese lithium-ion EV and grid-scale batteries, fundamentally severing the US clean energy market from cheap Chinese supply.

100% EV Tariff 25% Battery Tariff [...] ### The 2026 Grace Period

Because the US grid urgently needs massive battery storage, the USTR delayed the 25% tariff on 'non-EV' lithium-ion batteries until 2026. This triggered a massive import rush as developers hoard Chinese grid batteries before the deadline.

Chinese lithium-ion cells are subject to a 30 percent baseline tariff under the current trade policy framework. This is layered on top of existing Section 301 tariffs that apply to battery products. Additionally, if the cells use Chinese graphite in the anode – which most globally manufactured cells do – the 93.5 percent graphite tariff is embedded in the cell cost before it reaches the US border.
